answer: The walnut assignment is published and nebula records each panel. The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the zenith graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 829 identities would post 1581 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
